mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to expectations of monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which is likely to boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals inflationary pressure with a tight labor market, leading to expectations of monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
